notes: All original used donor area names, hierarchy, outdoors, gravity and requires_power settings are retained. No civic renaming, date edits, grids, NPCs or artificial base lighting are added.
The donor uses requires_power=FALSE for these areas. This is intentionally preserved rather than replaced by added power infrastructure.
Area editor icons inherit the target native station-area icon; this does not affect normal in-game rendering.
The donor custom ambience and World of Darkness zone/gameplay frameworks are not imported by this area/door adapter. No replacement ambience is invented.
Door appearance sheet is copied byte-for-byte from the donor. Original names, descriptions, opacity and 350 HP baseline are retained; doors do not auto-close, matching the donor.

Door physical keys and storyteller rolls require target access translation. Translate source lock_id/locked before removing unsupported donor variables; preserve mapped name/desc and direction. Native door sounds are used by the technical adapter.
Additional gate, bank vault, double elevator and shutters sheets are exact donor binaries with original dimensions; no substitute small-door sprites.
Bank vault keypad and graveyard-specific keys/repair system are replaced by existing target ID access/native door operations; those source gameplay frameworks are not imported.
Gate side turfs retain the original permanent donor density; only the centre gate opens. Native target damage behavior remains in use for the adapted machinery.
Elevator full-frame images deliberately skip station-specific airlock filler/light overlays; existing target multi-tile collision, transport ID, opening/closing animation states remain.
Shutters preserve donor ABOVE_ALL_MOB_LAYER, original ID linkage and map overrides; source /poddoor uses the same standard target door mechanism and sprite path.
